findings.gap: ownedSections items are validated against TARGET_REF (^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$) while the compared value, desired.changes[].field, is validated against ID (^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,255}$) -- any field name with an uppercase letter, dot, underscore, colon or leading digit is unrepresentable in policy and permanently rejected.

the recorded reason for leaving lifecycleEvents unenforced ("disjoint vocabularies for different concepts") is contradicted by the code: LIFECYCLE_EVENTS and FEATURE_STATES share four values verbatim (completed, superseded, abandoned, retained).
four deliberately deferred P-AC-11 dimensions (lifecycleEvents, previewRequired, retention, conflictPolicy) ship declarable and inert with no owner and no expiry recorded anywhere in the repository.

the new ownedSections gate calls .includes() on entry.ownedSections with no shape check, unlike planExternalReferenceWrite's other checks which coerce a wrong-shaped value defensively; a string value degrades ownership into a substring test and null throws an untyped TypeError.
docs/organization-policy-packs.md's exhaustive merge-algebra enumeration was not updated for the candidate's new hard-fail path and two new merge rules.
